case_title: Asim Shariiff v. National Investigation Agency
accused_occupation: President of Popular Front of India (PFI) in Bengaluru
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.3, s.27; UAP Act s.15, s.16, s.18, s.20
confession: Accused no. 4 confesses that accused appellant was the mastermind behind the killing of RSS members
aggravating_circumstances: Conspiracy, use of lethal weapon, intent to create fear and insecurity
trial_court_outcome: Dismissed the discharge application and framed charges
offence_finally_established: Conspiracy, murder, possession of unlicensed weapons, and offenses under UAP Act
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleges that a group of individuals conspired to kill an RSS member, resulting in his death. The incident occurred on 16th October 2016 when the victim was attacked with a sharp-edged weapon and killed. The accused, including the appellant, were arrested and investigated by the National Investigation Agency (NIA). The investigation revealed that the accused were members of a group involved in previous killings of RSS members. There were frequent communications among the accused prior to and after the incident, and evidence such as a banner with their names and photographs, call records, and a letter detailing past murders were recovered. The trial court and High Court found sufficient grounds to proceed with the case, concluding that a prima facie case of conspiracy and murder was made out.
